questions.question: Who took charge as new Cabinet Secretary of India in 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. T.V. Somanathan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dr. T.V. Somanathan** took charge as the new Cabinet Secretary of India in 2025, succeeding the previous incumbent.
 
• He is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the Tamil Nadu cadre, 1987 batch, with extensive experience in economic and administrative roles.
 
• Prior to his appointment, Dr. Somanathan served as the Finance Secretary of India, playing a crucial role in shaping financial policies and managing government expenditures.
 
• His appointment as Cabinet Secretary marks a significant milestone in his career, as this position is regarded as the senior-most civil servant in the Government of India.
 
• Dr. T.V. Somanathan is known for his expertise in public finance, policy formulation, and governance, making him a suitable candidate for the pivotal role of Cabinet Secretary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tarun Kapoor**:
 
 
• Tarun Kapoor is a retired IAS officer of the Himachal Pradesh cadre, 1987 batch.
 
• He served as an advisor to the Prime Minister of India, focusing on energy and infrastructure sectors.
 
• Kapoor played a pivotal role in policies related to renewable energy and energy transition during his tenure.
 
• His contributions include formulating strategies to achieve India’s sustainable energy goals.
 
 
 
• **Sanjay Kumar**:
 
 
• Sanjay Kumar is an IAS officer of the Bihar cadre, 1987 batch.
 
• He has held various administrative positions, including Secretary of the Department of Border Management in the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• His expertise lies in governance, disaster management, and border security affairs.
 
• Sanjay Kumar has contributed to India's efforts in enhancing border infrastructure and security protocols.
 
 
 
• **Arun Goel**:
 
 
• Arun Goel is an IAS officer of the Punjab cadre, 1985 batch.
 
• He served as the Secretary of the Ministry of Heavy Industries, where he focused on promoting industrial growth and technological advancements in India.
 
• Goel played a key role in policies related to the electric vehicle sector and manufacturing industries.
 
• His efforts were directed towards boosting India's industrial competitiveness and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Cabinet Secretary of India**:
 
 
• The Cabinet Secretary is the senior-most civil servant in India and head of the Indian Administrative Service.
 
• This role involves coordinating between different ministries and departments of the Indian government.
 
• The Cabinet Secretary also serves as the chief advisor to the Prime Minister and ensures the smooth functioning of the executive branch of the government.
 
• This position requires exceptional administrative skills, deep knowledge of governance, and leadership capabilities.

questions.question: In February 2026, which airline company appointed Captain Rohit Rikhye as the Head of Operations Control Centre (OCC)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IndiGo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IndiGo appointed Captain Rohit Rikhye as the new Head of Operations Control Centre (OCC) in February 2026 following operational disruptions in December 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Captain Rohit Rikhye replaced Jason Herter as Head of Operations Control Centre (OCC) with immediate effect.**
 
• The appointment followed major operational disruptions in December 2025, when over 4,500 flights were cancelled.
 
• The disruptions were primarily caused by an acute crew shortage due to the implementation of new Flight Duty Time Limitation (FDTL) norms.
 
• Rikhye, who has been with IndiGo for over 11 years, will oversee flight planning, tracking, dispatch, crew scheduling, and regulatory compliance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Operations Control Centre (OCC)**__

 __
 
• Responsible for real-time coordination and oversight of airline flight operations.
 
• Manages flight planning, tracking, dispatch, and operational decision-making.
 
• Ensures compliance with aviation safety regulations and air traffic control requirements.
 
 
 
• **Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)**__
 __
 
• India’s civil aviation regulatory authority.
 
• Imposed fines totaling ₹22 crore on IndiGo following the December 2025 disruptions.
 
• Oversees implementation of Flight Duty Time Limitation (FDTL) norms for crew safety.
 
 
 
• **Flight Duty Time Limitation (FDTL)**__
 
 
• Regulatory framework governing maximum working hours and rest periods for flight crew.
 
• Designed to prevent fatigue and enhance aviation safety.
 
• Implementation of revised norms contributed to crew shortages in late 2025.

questions.question: Which statement about Dr. K. Sivan is correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Led ISRO and launched NSAC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. K. Sivan served as the **Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** from January 2018 to January 2022.
 
• He played a pivotal role in **launching the National Space Agency Center (NSAC)** in India to promote private participation in space exploration.
 
• Dr. Sivan was involved in numerous landmark missions, including **Chandrayaan-2** and the initiation of the **Gaganyaan human spaceflight program**.
 
• He is a renowned aerospace engineer, credited with significant contributions to the development of PSLV, GSLV, and the cryogenic engine technology at ISRO.
 
• Dr. K. Sivan is popularly known as the "**Rocket Man of India**" for his exceptional contributions to India’s space research and satellite technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Headed DRDO**

 
 
• The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) works under the Ministry of Defence and is focused on developing advanced defense technologies.
 
• The DRDO is responsible for designing and developing defense systems such as missiles, armaments, electronics, and naval systems.
 
• Dr. G. Satheesh Reddy is one of the notable recent Chairmen of DRDO, but Dr. K. Sivan has no direct association with heading this organization.
 
 
 
• **Chaired HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited)**
 
 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) is an Indian state-owned aerospace and defense company headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• It is involved in the design, fabrication, and assembly of aircraft, jet engines, helicopters, and their spare parts.
 
• Dr. K. Sivan did not chair HAL; the organization operates independently from ISRO.
 
 
 
• **Invented propulsion technology**
 
 
• While Dr. K. Sivan is renowned for his expertise in aerospace engineering and contributed to propulsion systems, he did not specifically invent a propulsion technology.
 
• He contributed significantly to the development of cryogenic engine technology and mission design for ISRO’s launch vehicles, particularly PSLV and GSLV.

questions.question: Who is set to become Odisha’s first woman Chief Secretary, assuming office on January 1, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anu Garg.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Odisha IAS officer Anu Garg is set to assume charge as the state’s first woman Chief Secretary from January 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Anu Garg, a 1991-batch IAS officer of the Odisha cadre, will succeed Manoj Ahuja as Chief Secretary after his retirement on December 31, 2025.**
 
• **She will make history as the first woman to hold the Chief Secretary post in Odisha.**
 
• **In February 2023, Anu Garg became the first woman IAS officer to serve as Development Commissioner of Odisha.**
 
• **Her appointment signifies recognition of her administrative experience and contributions to governance in Odisha.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Chief Secretary__

 __
 
• The Chief Secretary is the senior-most civil servant in a state and serves as the administrative head of the state government.
 
• Responsible for coordinating the functioning of state departments and advising the state government on policy matters.
 
• The Chief Secretary also acts as a key liaison between the state and the central government.
 
 
 
• IAS Cadre__
 __
 
• The Indian Administrative Service (IAS) is the premier civil service of India responsible for administration, policy formulation, and governance.
 
• Officers are assigned to specific state cadres but can also serve in central government positions.
 
 
 
• Development Commissioner__
 __
 
• The Development Commissioner oversees state-level development programs and initiatives, focusing on economic and social development.
 
• Anu Garg’s prior role as Development Commissioner highlights her experience in state administration.
 
 
 
• Gender Milestone__
 
 
• Anu Garg’s appointment as the first woman Chief Secretary in Odisha is a historic milestone in promoting gender representation in top administrative positions.

questions.question: Which political party secured a landslide victory in the 13th Parliamentary Elections of Bangladesh held on February 12, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 13, 2026, results confirmed that the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), led by Tarique Rahman, won a sweeping majority in the country's first general election since the 2024 uprising.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Victory:** The BNP and its allies secured a decisive mandate, winning at least **212 out of 299 seats** in the Jatiya Sangsad, crossing the two-thirds majority mark.
 
• **Tarique Rahman:** The son of former PM Khaleda Zia, Tarique Rahman, contested and won from both the **Dhaka-17** and **Bogura-6** constituencies and is poised to become the next Prime Minister.
 
• **Referendum:** Alongside the election, a constitutional referendum on the **'July Charter'** (reforms proposed by the interim government) was held, which received overwhelming public approval (approx. 72.9%).
 
• **Exclusion:** The **Awami League**, the party of ousted leader Sheikh Hasina, was barred from participating in these elections by the interim administration led by Muhammad Yunus.
 
• **Opposition:** The **Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami** emerged as the second-largest party/alliance, securing around 77 seats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• International Reaction__

 __
 
• Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** was among the first global leaders to congratulate Tarique Rahman, reaffirming India's commitment to bilateral ties.
 
 
 
• Interim Government__
 
 
• Nobel Laureate **Muhammad Yunus**, who served as the Chief Adviser of the interim government, is expected to hand over power to the newly elected government by mid-February 2026.

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court in March 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Harish Tandon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Harish Tandon was appointed as the Chief Justice of the Orissa High Court in March 2025.
 
• He replaced the outgoing Chief Justice, bringing in his vast judicial experience to lead the High Court.
 
• Justice Tandon has a distinguished career in law, serving in various capacities in the judiciary before this appointment.
 
• His appointment as the Chief Justice was made by the President of India in consultation with the Collegium, following the established procedure for judicial appointments in India.
 
• The Orissa High Court, located in Cuttack, is one of the prominent High Courts in India, with jurisdiction over the state of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Joymalya Bagchi**
 
 
• Justice Joymalya Bagchi is a notable judge who has served in various capacities in the Indian judiciary.
 
• He has contributed significantly to the legal framework with his judgments and legal acumen.
 
• Although not associated with the Orissa High Court, his name is prominent in other judicial roles.
 
 
 
• **Justice Arun Palli**
 
 
• Justice Arun Palli is a judge with a remarkable career in the Indian judiciary.
 
• He has been involved in significant legal decisions and is known for his expertise in constitutional and civil matters.
 
• He is associated with a different High Court and was not appointed as the Chief Justice of Orissa High Court.
 
 
 
• **Justice Hima Kohli**
 
 
• Justice Hima Kohli is a distinguished judge and has served as the Chief Justice of Telangana High Court.
 
• She has a reputation for her in-depth understanding of legal issues and her contribution to justice delivery in India.
 
• Her appointment as Chief Justice was for another High Court, not the Orissa High Court.
 
 
 
• **Orissa High Court**
 
 
• The Orissa High Court was established on 26 July 1948 and serves as the apex legal authority in the state of Odisha.
 
• It is located in Cuttack and addresses a wide range of legal matters, including constitutional, civil, and criminal cases.
 
• The Chief Justice of a High Court plays a crucial role in administering justice and overseeing the functioning of the judiciary within its jurisdiction.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as India’s new **High Commissioner to Bangladesh**, succeeding **Pranay Verma** in 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dinesh Trivedi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dinesh Trivedi** arrived in **Bangladesh** via the **Benapole land port** to formally take charge as **India’s High Commissioner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

• His appointment was officially announced by the **Ministry of External Affairs** on **April 27**.
 
• He received his **Letters of Credence** from **President Droupadi Murmu** on **June 5** before assuming the post.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: In January 2025, who has been appointed as the India's new Ambassador to Israel?

• **Jitender Pal Singh** has been appointed as India's new Ambassador to Israel in **January 2025**.

• The appointment comes amidst strengthening diplomatic relations between **India and Israel**, focusing on areas such as **technology, defense, agriculture, and innovation.**

• Ambassadors play a crucial role in representing India's interests in foreign countries and fostering bilateral cooperation.

• India and Israel have shared a strong relationship since the establishment of diplomatic ties in **1992**, with collaborations in sectors like **counter-terrorism, water management, and cybersecurity.**

• The role of an ambassador involves facilitating agreements, coordinating diplomatic missions, and promoting cultural exchange between the two nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **India-Israel Relations:**

• India officially recognized Israel in **1950**, but formal diplomatic ties were established in **1992**.

• Key areas of collaboration include **defense technology**, agricultural advancements, and strategic partnerships in combating terrorism.

• In **2017**, Indian Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** became the first Indian PM to visit Israel, further strengthening bilateral ties.

• **Role of Ambassadors:**

• An ambassador is the highest-ranking diplomat representing their nation in a foreign country.

• They are responsible for promoting economic, cultural, and political interests and maintaining bilateral relations.

• Ambassadors coordinate negotiations, treaties, and agreements between nations.

• **Israel's Importance to India:**

• Israel is one of India's leading partners in the defense sector, supplying cutting-edge military technology.

• India imports agricultural innovations, water management technologies, and cybersecurity tools from Israel.

• Israel is also a key player in India's energy and renewable energy initiatives.

• **Diplomatic Appointments:**

• Diplomatic appointments are decided by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) in India.

• Such appointments are crucial in strengthening global partnerships and advancing India's foreign policy objectives.

• Ambassadors are often chosen based on their expertise in foreign relations and their ability to represent India effectively on international platforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **India-Israel Defense Collaboration:**

• India is the largest buyer of Israeli military equipment, ranging from drones to missile defense systems.

• Israel has supported India's defense modernization efforts and provides joint research and development opportunities.

• **Strategic Cooperation:**

• Both countries collaborate on counter-terrorism strategies and intelligence sharing to combat global security challenges.

• Israel has supported India on issues like border security and fighting terrorism in international forums.

• **Agricultural and Water Management:**

• Israel's drip irrigation and water recycling technologies have been widely adopted in India to improve agricultural productivity.

• Joint projects focus on enhancing rural livelihoods and combating water scarcity issues.

questions.question: Who is the current Director (Chief) of India's Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Sinha, IPS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Sinha**, an **IPS officer from the 1988 batch of the Chhattisgarh cadre**, is the current Director of the **Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW)**, India’s foreign intelligence agency.
 
• He succeeded **Samant Kumar Goel**, who was the Chief of R&AW from **2019 to 2023**. The appointment of Ravi Sinha was officially announced in **June 2023**.
 
• Ravi Sinha has an extensive career in intelligence and security, with over **three decades** of experience in handling various operational and strategic responsibilities within R&AW.
 
• His expertise lies in **foreign intelligence**, counter-terrorism, and national security, making him a highly suitable candidate for this critical role.
 
• R&AW plays a vital role in safeguarding India’s strategic interests globally, and Ravi Sinha’s leadership is expected to strengthen the agency’s operations further.
 
• The Director of R&AW is appointed by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)** chaired by the Prime Minister of India. This ensures that the selection is based on merit and operational expertise.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Ravi Sinha, IPS.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Research and Analysis Wing (R&AW):**

 
 
• R&AW is India’s premier foreign intelligence agency, established in **1968** following the intelligence failures of the **1962 Indo-China war** and the **1965 Indo-Pak war**.
 
• The agency operates under the guidance of the **Prime Minister’s Office (PMO)** and is not answerable to Parliament, ensuring operational secrecy.
 
• R&AW’s primary functions include gathering **foreign intelligence**, counter-terrorism operations, and counter-proliferation efforts. It also oversees the security of Indian assets abroad.
 
 
 
• **Directors of R&AW:**
 
 
• The Director of R&AW is usually an **Indian Police Service (IPS)** officer or an officer from other intelligence agencies such as the Intelligence Bureau (IB).
 
• Prominent Directors include **Rameshwar Nath Kao**, the founding chief of R&AW, and **Samant Kumar Goel**, who was instrumental in counter-terrorism operations during his tenure.
 
 
 
• **Challenges and Importance:**
 
 
• R&AW faces challenges such as technological advancements in espionage, cyber threats, and geopolitical tensions in the region.
 
• The agency plays a critical role in protecting India’s strategic interests, particularly in regions like **South Asia**, the **Middle East**, and **East Asia**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Appointment Procedure:**

 
 
• The Director of R&AW is selected by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**, which is chaired by the Prime Minister.
 
• The appointment is based on the officer’s operational experience and contribution to national security.
 
 
 
• **Ravi Sinha’s Background:**
 
 
• Ravi Sinha has served in several key roles within R&AW, including leading operations in **counter-terrorism** and intelligence gathering.
 
• His expertise in handling strategic challenges makes him a valuable asset to India’s intelligence framework.

questions.question: In July 2025, Kavinder Gupta, who served as Deputy Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir, assumed the office of Lieutenant Governor of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kavinder Gupta**, a senior Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader, served as the **Deputy Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir**. His political experience and administrative contributions have been noteworthy in the region.
 
• In **July 2025**, Kavinder Gupta assumed the office of **Lieutenant Governor (LG) of Ladakh**. Ladakh is a Union Territory (UT) in India, formed after the bifurcation of Jammu and Kashmir under the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019**.
 
• The position of Lieutenant Governor in Ladakh was created after the region was made a Union Territory in **October 2019**. The LG acts as the administrative head of the Union Territory.
 
• As the Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh, Kavinder Gupta's key responsibilities include overseeing the region's administration, ensuring the implementation of central government schemes, and addressing issues specific to Ladakh's development and governance.
 
• **Ladakh** is strategically significant for India, sharing borders with China and Pakistan. The Lieutenant Governor plays an essential role in maintaining security and fostering development in this sensitive region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Formation of Ladakh as a Union Territory:**

 
 
• Ladakh became a Union Territory on **31 October 2019**, following the abrogation of Article 370 of the Constitution of India.
 
• The **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019**, bifurcated the former state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
 
• Ladakh comprises two districts: **Leh** and **Kargil**.
 
• The Union Territory of Ladakh does not have a legislative assembly, and its governance is administered directly by the Lieutenant Governor.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Lieutenant Governor:**
 
 
• The Lieutenant Governor (LG) serves as the administrative head of a Union Territory.
 
• In Ladakh, the LG works closely with the central government to implement policies and maintain law and order.
 
• The LG is responsible for addressing local governance issues, ensuring development, and fostering harmony in the region.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance of Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh shares borders with **China (Tibet Autonomous Region)** to the east and **Pakistan-administered Gilgit-Baltistan** to the west.
 
• It is a region of geopolitical significance due to its proximity to the **Line of Actual Control (LAC)** and the **Line of Control (LoC).**
 
• Ladakh is also known for its unique geographical features, including the **Himalayas**, the **Karakoram Range**, and the **Indus River Basin**.
 
 
 
• **Economic and Cultural Aspects of Ladakh:**
 
 
• Ladakh's economy is primarily based on **tourism, agriculture, and animal husbandry**.
 
• The region is known for its unique **Buddhist culture**, monasteries, and festivals, which attract tourists globally.
 
• Efforts are being made to promote sustainable development, including solar energy projects and eco-tourism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019:**

 
 
• This act reorganized the state of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories: Jammu & Kashmir (with a legislative assembly) and Ladakh (without a legislative assembly).
 
• The act was passed by the Parliament of India on **5 August 2019**.
 
 
 
• **First Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh:**
 
 
• **Radha Krishna Mathur** was the first Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh, appointed on **31 October 2019**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Lieutenant Governor's Role:**
 
 
• The LG acts as a bridge between the central government and the Union Territory, ensuring effective implementation of policies and addressing the needs of the local population.
